Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet West, Mid-Century, Oak Distinct Grain Chest Bedroom Dresser, 38"W, Dark Oak Finish
Colors: Brown
Materials: Hardwood
Add the perfect touch of originality to your bedroom with this mid-century dresser. The brass pulls and concealed drawer glides provide a modern style, while veneer made from hand-selected quarter-sawn oak adds a distinctive grain. 38"W x 19"D x 52"H Solid hardwoods with finish of wire-brushed matte dark oak Modern and simple yet distinctive design No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Drawers are suspended on easy opening, concealed, self-closing extension guides
